Calculate Anything is a native Swift Alfred workflow: no PHP, no API keys.
Type a calculation that starts with a digit, or use a keyword: calc, =, #, (, %, vat, tip, frac, invest, cost, price, tax, was, time, rgb, hsl, sqrt, what, days, contrast, lighten, darken and more.
Examples: 100 usd to eur, 10 km, 10 km to mi, 5 ft 3 in to cm, tip 85 at 18% split 3, time 10 days after 2026-12-25, 20% of 150, 255 to hex, 3pm in PT, #ff8800, calc what is 20% of 150.
Rates come from Frankfurter, fawazahmed0/currency-api, CoinGecko and Coinbase, cached on disk, with an offline fallback. `_caclear` clears the cached rates and `_carefresh` refreshes them now. Source and docs: see the repository README.
